basis.zh: 战略资源均可触达；以三年愿景、12–24个月首轮主周期组织推进。前期关系经营、客户排期与交付作业分别安排，按季度滚动调整。
basis.en: All strategic resources are reachable. Plan around a three-year vision and12–24month initial cycle. Distinguish relationship development, customer schedules and delivery effort, reviewing quarterly.

accounts.name: Emaar

entry.zh: 先以既有信任关系提出商管/资产运营的业务议题；尊重原有联络链，约定由对方指定业务与数字化负责人。
entry.en: Use the existing trust relationship to frame a property-operations issue; respect the contact chain and ask the counterpart to nominate operations and digital owners.

offer.zh: 租户/供应商履约凭证、工程验收及跨组织对账；先做一项B2B工作流，不从不动产代币发行切入。
offer.en: Tenant / supplier performance evidence, project acceptance or reconciliation. Start with a B2B workflow, not real-estate token issuance.

role.zh: 商管/资产运营负责人＋数字化＋采购法务；租赁经纪入口须转到实际流程买方。
role.en: Property operations + digital + procurement / legal. A leasing intermediary must refer to the actual workflow buyer.

next.zh: 会前提交一页议题和两页执行说明；直接安排关系/业务会；会后2–3个工作日整理共识，下一次沟通时间与对方约定、对口负责人和下一步。
next.en: Send a one-page agenda and two-page execution brief; arrange a direct relationship / business meeting; confirm agreement, owners and next actions within2–3workingdays, agreeing the next contact date with the counterpart.

gate.zh: 关系赞助人认可议题，并由具体业务负责人确认问题、权限及下一步；采购预算另行核实。
gate.en: The relationship sponsor accepts the theme and a business owner confirms the problem, authority and next step; qualify procurement funding separately.

stop.zh: 房地产洽谈不等于数字化采购权；未转介到业务买方时不报项目金额。
stop.en: Property discussions do not confer digital procurement authority. No opportunity value before a buyer referral.

accounts.access_basis: Q-ACCESS-20261028 / four retained Middle East organizations

social_role.zh: 直接对话入口；会前明确业务赞助人与正式工作组。
social_role.en: Direct dialogue; identify the business sponsor and formal working group before progressing.

reciprocity.zh: 先完成一份租户/供应商履约或工程验收流程诊断，再共同评估可信记录的价值。
reciprocity.en: Offer a bounded tenant / supplier or project-acceptance process review, then assess the value of verifiable records together.

accounts.name: Al-Futtaim

entry.zh: 从现有集团关系进入具体业务单元；以一个可共同承担的小问题建立部门间信任与交付记录。
entry.en: Enter a specific business unit through the existing group relationship; build departmental trust through a small, jointly owned problem.

offer.zh: 汽车售后/供应商跨方凭证、地产供应商对账；优先选单业务单元的小范围流程验证。
offer.en: Cross-party automotive / supplier credentials or property-supplier reconciliation; choose a bounded workflow in one business unit.

role.zh: 业务单元数字化负责人＋供应链/运营＋采购；金融服务仅在许可边界清楚后另议。
role.en: Business-unit digital lead + supply chain / operations + procurement. Financial-service use cases require a separately defined permission boundary.

next.zh: 会前提交一页议题和两页执行说明；直接安排关系/业务会；会后2–3个工作日整理共识，下一次沟通时间与对方约定、对口负责人和下一步。
next.en: Send a one-page agenda and two-page execution brief; arrange a direct relationship / business meeting; confirm agreement, owners and next actions within2–3workingdays, agreeing the next contact date with the counterpart.

gate.zh: 关系赞助人认可议题，并由具体业务负责人确认问题、权限及下一步；采购预算另行核实。
gate.en: The relationship sponsor accepts the theme and a business owner confirms the problem, authority and next step; qualify procurement funding separately.

stop.zh: 若现有系统已覆盖且无跨方信任问题，不强推上链，转为普通集成评估或退出。
stop.en: If current systems suffice and no cross-party trust problem exists, assess ordinary integration or exit.

accounts.access_basis: Q-ACCESS-20261028 / four retained Middle East organizations

social_role.zh: 直接对话入口；会前明确业务赞助人与正式工作组。
social_role.en: Direct dialogue; identify the business sponsor and formal working group before progressing.

reciprocity.zh: 以汽车/供应商凭证或跨单位对账作为共同工作议题，形成可复核流程与人员培训。
reciprocity.en: Co-design an automotive / supplier credential or reconciliation workflow, with reviewable processes and staff training.

accounts.name: Saif Belhasa Holding

entry.zh: 由现有直接入口协调家族/集团赞助人与职业管理团队；将高层认可落实为具名的运营工作组。
entry.en: Use direct access to align the family / group sponsor with professional management, turning executive support into a named operating team.

offer.zh: 供应商履约、车辆/设备证照与跨公司验收记录核验；一期仅选一种凭证和两类参与方。
offer.en: Verify supplier performance, vehicle / equipment credentials or cross-entity acceptance records. Start with one credential type and two participant roles.

role.zh: 业务运营负责人＋IT架构＋采购/财务；集团高层负责转介，不替代买方。
role.en: Business operations + IT architecture + procurement / finance. Executive access supports referral, not buyer qualification.

next.zh: 会前提交一页议题和两页执行说明；直接安排关系/业务会；会后2–3个工作日整理共识，下一次沟通时间与对方约定、对口负责人和下一步。
next.en: Send a one-page agenda and two-page execution brief; arrange a direct relationship / business meeting; confirm agreement, owners and next actions within2–3workingdays, agreeing the next contact date with the counterpart.

gate.zh: 关系赞助人认可议题，并由具体业务负责人确认问题、权限及下一步；采购预算另行核实。
gate.en: The relationship sponsor accepts the theme and a business owner confirms the problem, authority and next step; qualify procurement funding separately.

stop.zh: 若只有集团介绍、无业务负责人或数据样本，保留为资源线索，不进入金额预测。
stop.en: If access stops at a group introduction without a process owner or sample, retain as a lead with no forecast value.

accounts.access_basis: Q-ACCESS-20261028 / four retained Middle East organizations

social_role.zh: 直接对话入口；会前明确业务赞助人与正式工作组。
social_role.en: Direct dialogue; identify the business sponsor and formal working group before progressing.

reciprocity.zh: 围绕工业、汽车或供应商记录开展小范围验证；以交付、知识分享和本地团队能力建设回馈合作。
reciprocity.en: Validate an industrial, automotive or supplier-record workflow; contribute delivery, knowledge sharing and local team capability.

accounts.name: DMCC / member-trader discovery

entry.zh: 与DMCC建立生态层面的信任与议题合作，再由其推荐适配成员；成员公司单独决定采购。
entry.en: Build ecosystem-level trust and an agreed theme with DMCC, then seek suitable member referrals; members make their own purchasing decisions.

offer.zh: 现有Tradeflow等平台之外的凭证衔接或跨境协同缺口；先调查互补价值，不宣称替代既有基础设施。
offer.en: Investigate credential interoperability or cross-border gaps outside existing platforms such as Tradeflow; establish complementarity, not a replacement claim.

role.zh: 生态/商品业务团队＋候选贸易企业运营、财务与IT；DMCC不自动作为平台买方。
role.en: Ecosystem / commodity teams + trader operations, finance and IT. DMCC is not automatically the platform buyer.

next.zh: 会前提交一页议题和两页执行说明；直接安排关系/业务会；会后2–3个工作日整理共识，下一次沟通时间与对方约定、对口负责人和下一步。
next.en: Send a one-page agenda and two-page execution brief; arrange a direct relationship / business meeting; confirm agreement, owners and next actions within2–3workingdays, agreeing the next contact date with the counterpart.

gate.zh: 关系赞助人认可议题，并由具体业务负责人确认问题、权限及下一步；采购预算另行核实。
gate.en: The relationship sponsor accepts the theme and a business owner confirms the problem, authority and next step; qualify procurement funding separately.

stop.zh: 自由区设立、生态活动或会员身份不等于订单；未形成独立买方不计销售机会。
stop.en: Registration, events or membership are not orders; no qualified opportunity without an independent buyer.

accounts.access_basis: Q-ACCESS-20261028 / four retained Middle East organizations

social_role.zh: 直接对话入口；会前明确业务赞助人与正式工作组。
social_role.en: Direct dialogue; identify the business sponsor and formal working group before progressing.

reciprocity.zh: 提供贸易凭证互操作演示与小型业务交流；先理解Tradeflow等既有系统，再评估协作缺口。
reciprocity.en: Offer a trade-credential interoperability demo and focused dialogue; understand existing systems such as Tradeflow before assessing gaps.

accounts.name: Nayef bin Abdullah bin Saud route
accounts.name_zh: 纳伊夫·本·阿卜杜拉·本·沙特通路
accounts.access_basis: Q-ACCESS-ALL-20261028 / resource package routes confirmed reachable; activation requires time and cost

social_role.zh: 可触达的沙特王室关系入口；用于议题引荐与信任承接，非国家采购授权。
social_role.en: A Saudi royal relationship route confirmed reachable; intended for introductions and trust sponsorship, not state procurement authority.

entry.zh: 通过资源包所列王室关系组织产业议题交流；会前完成议题、材料与参会层级安排。
entry.en: Use the reachable royal route for industry dialogue; prepare the theme, materials and participant levels.

offer.zh: 提出产业供应链、资产/履约记录中的一个具体问题，请求指向有职责的运营企业。
offer.en: Present one industrial supply-chain or asset / performance-record problem and seek a referral to an accountable operating company.

reciprocity.zh: 贡献产业方案、技术演示和本地能力建设；对引荐人反馈可核实进度，不以个人报酬交换影响力。
reciprocity.en: Contribute solutions, demonstrations and local capability; give the introducer verifiable progress, without buying influence.

next.zh: 先发送可转发的一页议题，征得转介同意；获企业联系人后安排小范围工作会。
next.en: Send a forwardable one-page theme and obtain permission to refer; arrange a focused working meeting after an enterprise owner is identified.

gate.zh: 具名运营企业、业务赞助人及明确问题；符合条件后建立独立买方账户。
gate.en: Named operating company, business sponsor and defined problem; only then create a separate buyer account.

stop.zh: 不以关系通路推断王室投资承诺、政府担保或项目预算。
stop.en: Do not infer royal investment, government guarantee or a project budget from access.

accounts.name: Turki bin Khalid bin Faisal route
accounts.name_zh: 图尔基·本·哈立德·本·费萨尔通路
accounts.access_basis: Q-ACCESS-ALL-20261028 / resource package routes confirmed reachable; activation requires time and cost

social_role.zh: 可触达的沙特王室/产业关系入口；用于产业议题与企业转介。
social_role.en: A Saudi royal / industry route confirmed reachable, for thematic dialogue and enterprise referrals.

entry.zh: 通过可触达的王室/产业关系切入地产、文旅或供应商协作；以共同利益和可交付方案组织对话。
entry.en: Use the reachable royal / industry route for property, tourism or supplier cooperation, grounded in mutual value and a deliverable proposition.

offer.zh: 以地产、文旅运营或供应商协作的可信记录作为待讨论场景，由对方确定真实业务主体。
offer.en: Propose verifiable records for property, tourism operations or supplier collaboration; let the counterpart identify the actual business entity.

reciprocity.zh: 提供适配本地议题的方案和可检验小成果，尊重既有赞助关系及长期合作节奏。
reciprocity.en: Offer relevant solutions and testable small outcomes, respecting existing sponsorship and long-term cooperation.

next.zh: 先讨论主题适配与合作利益，再请对方指定工作层；双方确认后进入方案共创。
next.en: Discuss fit and mutual value, then invite a nominated working-level owner; co-design only after agreement.

gate.zh: 业务拥有者接受议题且愿提供流程信息；采购权与付款主体另行确认。
gate.en: A process owner accepts the theme and shares workflow information; qualify purchasing authority and payer separately.

stop.zh: 对话不自动构成背书；不将礼节性会面计为商机或收入。
stop.en: Dialogue is not endorsement; courtesy meetings are not opportunities or revenue.

accounts.name: Yasir Al-Rumayyan business-circle route
accounts.name_zh: Yasir Al-Rumayyan 相关商务圈层
accounts.access_basis: Q-ACCESS-ALL-20261028 / resource package routes confirmed reachable; activation requires time and cost

social_role.zh: 可触达的主权基金/大型产业决策圈层入口；与最终企业采购分层。
social_role.en: A reachable sovereign-investment / industry-circle route, separate from end-company procurement.

entry.zh: 通过已具备的商务圈层进入产业价值讨论；围绕具体项目归口组织专题材料、引荐和工作层对接。PIF Governor、Aramco董事长为公开职务背景。
entry.en: Use the reachable business circle for industry-value dialogue; prepare a focused brief, introductions and working-level engagement around a specific project. PIF Governor and Aramco Chairman are public-role context.

offer.zh: 围绕具体产业运营问题寻求项目归口；PIF、Aramco、NEOM分别确认业务实体、采购入口与项目负责人。
offer.en: Seek an accountable project owner around a specific operating problem. Qualify PIF, Aramco and NEOM entities, procurement routes and project owners separately.

reciprocity.zh: 以可复核技术价值、本地能力培养与长期运营承诺形成合作理由，不使用基金规模替代订单依据。
reciprocity.en: Offer verifiable technology value, local capability and long-term operations; fund size is not an order basis.

next.zh: 先形成2页产业价值说明，安排议题会与指定企业的工作层对接。
next.en: Prepare a two-page industry-value brief, then arrange thematic dialogue and working-level engagement with a nominated enterprise.

gate.zh: 实际运营/采购主体、业务赞助与可验证需求齐备；任何投资或采购单独立项。
gate.en: Identify operator / buyer, sponsor and verifiable demand; investment and procurement are separate decisions.

stop.zh: 不把一个圈层视为同时获得三家机构授权；不沿用原件“PIF主席/NEOM董事长”的合并归属。
stop.en: One relationship circle does not authorize all three institutions. Do not carry forward conflated PIF / NEOM leadership claims.

entry.en: Use the reachable advisory / industry network for focused dialogue connecting named enterprises with cross-regional cooperation themes.

offer.zh: 以小型产业闭门交流串联具名企业，把区域议题转为企业问题与项目归口。
offer.en: Use focused industry dialogue to connect named companies and translate regional themes into owned business problems.

reciprocity.zh: 分享行业研究、培训和经过授权的项目经验，形成长期可兑现的合作价值。
reciprocity.en: Share industry insight, training and authorized project experience to build sustained, deliverable value.

next.zh: 先确认交流权限、召集对象和披露范围；获得具体企业引荐后再建销售账户。
next.en: Confirm convening permission, participants and disclosure scope; create a sales account only after a specific company referral.

gate.zh: 具名企业、对口业务角色、会议议题与下一步形成记录。
gate.en: Record a named company, relevant role, meeting theme and next action.

stop.zh: 顾问/荣誉称谓不写成联盟官方采购或22国授权；关系细节仅按约定范围披露。
stop.en: Advisory / honorary titles are not official procurement or authority across 22 countries; disclose relationship details only within agreed scope.
